findings: Desktop list separates groups and preserves six counts; doing/todo cards readable, done/dropped disclosures collapsed as intended.
Desktop kanban uses four columns at 1440px; card titles, paths and priority wrap without overlap.
390px kanban becomes one column; counts and tools wrap within viewport, long paths remain readable.
Dark theme titles, small metadata and outlines remain readable on dark surfaces.
Done search expands and shows exactly two cards with unchanged overall counts.
Custom review, unknown blocked and unset states are visibly separate with one card each.
Empty case displays zero counts and explicit empty message.
No-JavaScript fallback hides enhancement controls and retains native disclosure and rendered-body links.
limitations: Visual inspection is qualitative; no numerical color contrast audit.
Python-rendered fixture in Chromium153.0.8010.12; Node parity is covered separately by implementation tests.
